title: Flow Service Management: use native HttpClient instead of Web Request Helper
summary: Flow Service Management.GetEnvironments now calls the endpoint through native AL HttpClient instead of Web Request Helper. URL validation, the Bearer token as a secret, error handling and UTF-8 charset handling stay as before. The request is now subject to the extension's outbound HTTP policy.
key_points: Replaces Web Request Helper.GetResponseTextUsingCharset with a local TryGetResponseText try function built on HttpClient
Keeps http/https URI validation, the Bearer token sent as a secret, failure on a non-success status, and UTF-8 charset detection
Removes the last caller of GetResponseTextUsingCharset, which is a prerequisite for obsoleting codeunit 1299 in #12615
OnPrem-scoped code path with no public API change
